Questions

FAQs

Black tie! We want to see you absolutely stunning — tuxedos, floor-length gowns, and your most dazzling self are strongly encouraged. (We will absolutely be judging. Lovingly, of course.) Please skip white, ivory, and champagne out of respect for the bride.

Plus-ones are by invitation only. When you enter your RSVP code, you'll see exactly who is included in your invitation — no guessing required! If you have questions, feel free to reach out directly.

We love your little ones! However, we have chosen to keep our wedding an adults-only evening. We hope this gives you a chance to enjoy a wonderful night out, and we appreciate your understanding.

We are working on shuttle arrangements between the hotel block and The White Room. Details will be sent closer to the date. Uber and Lyft are also readily available throughout St. Augustine.

Parking is available nearby. We recommend arriving 15–20 minutes early to allow time to park and find your seat comfortably.
